svg.title: The spans a second one core holds over TLS, connect-zig, connect-go and connect-rust, each with and without protovalidate, as one gateway core for 33,000 servers

svg.text: Rate kept with protovalidate: connect-zig 74%, connect-go 49%, connect-rust 85%
Each server holds 516 connections over TLS, as one core of a 64-core gateway for 33,000 servers, and
takes gzip OTLP exports of 16, 128 and 512 spans. The rate climbs until p99 passes 100 ms or a call is refused.
Each share is a receiver's spans a second with protovalidate over its own without. A dashed line is a
receiver that validates. Each bar is the median of the rounds, and its whisker spans the rates they held.
The right panel gives each server's first round, which climbs from the lowest rate.
One CI job ran all, and checked every span: run 313, commit c6cce91, AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor, 4 CPUs.
Spans a second one core holds
▲ marks a value 5% or more better than v0.6.0's, ▼ one that much worse, and a dashed line v0.6.0's value.
